shots.generation_prompt: Create one continuous 10-second vertical 9:16 live-action macro coffee commercial sequence. CONTINUITY AND MATERIAL LOCK: one dark real wooden surface, freshly roasted dark-brown coffee beans with natural pores and oil, real ground coffee, one warm-white ceramic cup, deep black coffee, and a single narrow amber dawn beam moving visually from lower left toward upper right. No person. VISUAL GOAL: light does not appear as magic; ordinary sunrise illumination gradually reveals the physical origin of coffee, ending on the first brewed drop. INTERNAL SHOT TIMELINE: 0.0–2.6s — begin almost black at tabletop level with a 100mm macro lens; [very slow truck right] travels only a few centimetres along a diagonal trail of beans as the narrow beam catches three oily ridges one after another; extreme shallow depth, foreground texture enters focus naturally. 2.6–4.7s — motivated hard cut on matching amber highlight to an extreme macro of one bean splitting open into a small bed of freshly ground coffee; do not explode or float it; show only a restrained real grinder-result transition, tiny irregular particles settling under gravity; [static]. 4.7–7.3s — cut to top/side macro of hot water first touching the coffee bed; the dark powder swells and blooms slowly, releasing small realistic carbon-dioxide bubbles and amber crema veins; [slow dolly in], no visible kettle or hand, only the controlled edge of a thin water stream; believable fluid absorption. 7.3–10.0s — graphic match cut from one crema bubble to a single viscous brewed-coffee drop suspended over the same warm-white cup; high-speed photography slows the drop as it descends toward the dark liquid; a small real ripple begins below it, no giant splash. End with the drop one centimetre above the surface and hold the final 0.5 seconds as the exact interface state for segment two. PHOTOGRAPHY: real high-speed product cinematography, 100mm macro optics, deep neutral blacks, protected ceramic whites, narrow amber rim light, subtle sensor grain, truthful surface tension, gravity, particle settling and heat; elegant restrained black-and-gold palette, not synthetic luxury CGI. AUDIO POLICY: no dialogue, no voice and no music generated in this segment; only isolated bean tick, gentle wet bloom and one close liquid drop for later sound design. NEVER SHOW: people, hands, faces, coffee drinking, floating beans, exploding powder, giant crown splash, magic particles, sparks, glowing symbols, fantasy smoke, illustration, anime, 3D render, plastic beans, fake ceramic, text, logo, watermark, equipment clutter, food, speed ramp, orbit, whip pan, shaky camera or excessive lens flare.

shots.generation_prompt: Create one continuous 10-second vertical 9:16 live-action high-speed coffee sequence. CONTINUITY LOCK: begin from the exact prior state — one real dark coffee drop one centimetre above the liquid inside the same warm-white ceramic cup on the same dark wooden table; cup handle remains on screen right; narrow amber dawn light and deep black background remain consistent. VISUAL GOAL: show light acquiring visible form through real coffee fluid, reflection, ceramic shadow and backlit steam; spectacular but physically grounded, never supernatural. INTERNAL SHOT TIMELINE: 0.0–2.5s — 100mm extreme macro, [static], the single drop falls under gravity and contacts the black coffee surface; show a small elegant crown and concentric ripple in true high-speed slow motion, then the crown collapses naturally; protected highlights, no oversized splash. 2.5–4.8s — action-match cut to a top-down macro following the outward ripple; rectangular window-grid reflections stretch and bend across the moving liquid, amber highlights travel along the wave and settle; [very slow clockwise roll] no more than five degrees, keeping the cup rim circular and physically stable. 4.8–7.0s — match cut from the circular ripple to the curved cup handle and its shadow; profile close shot, [slow truck right], straight window-grid shadow crosses the curved handle shadow on the wooden grain, forming one clean balanced graphic relationship; cup itself does not rotate or mutate. 7.0–10.0s — camera gently [dolly out] through naturally rising steam to reveal the complete cup; backlight makes thin translucent steam layers visible against black while the coffee surface still reflects the window grid; 85mm lens, elegant shallow focus breathing. Hold the final 0.6 seconds on the same complete cup with handle right and steam rising, providing a stable interface state for segment three. PHOTOGRAPHY AND PHYSICS: real high-speed liquid capture, real ceramic glaze, physically accurate surface tension, ripple decay, reflection, shadow direction and convection steam; black-and-amber chiaroscuro, mild film grain, no overexposure, no artificial volumetric effects. AUDIO POLICY: no dialogue, voice or generated music; retain only one close drop impact, subtle low liquid resonance and quiet air for later mix. NEVER SHOW: people, hands, drinking, repeated drops, continuous pouring, giant CGI splash, magical glow, sparks, floating particles, faces or symbols in steam, changing cup, extra cup, impossible reflections, anime, illustration, 3D render, plastic surfaces, text, logo, watermark, food props, orbit, whip pan or camera shake.
